question: Which measured B-Rep facts distinguish a bounded blind cylindrical cut from a through cylindrical cut, and when must the system stop rather than assert cut extent?
model_class: cylindrical subtractive extent with locally similar walls and distinct termination evidence

ambiguity_or_fail_closed_conditions: the facts do not distinguish blind from through extent

constrained_hypothesis: A cut-extent hypothesis may be proposed only when recorded terminal-face or through-connectivity facts discriminate it; otherwise the result remains ambiguous or unsupported.

stopping_rule: do not turn a feature label into an observable
do not promote the existing deterministic hole oracle as Q01 recognition evidence

existing: prismatic-hole-v1 contains family-scoped blind and through deterministic replay evidence, but no reviewed Q01 observable unit or same-condition discriminating audit.
missing_counterexample: a locally similar cylindrical pattern whose termination/connectivity facts are ambiguous or unavailable
evidence.next_minimal_experiment: Completed by M30-002: the offline reporter classified the frozen three through development records and three blind held-out records from measured adjacency and planar-footprint facts; the multi-cylinder counterbore control stayed unsupported. Any extension must isolate a new geometry or axis condition without widening this rule.
